versos.hebraico: פְּתַ֥ח לְבָנ֖וֹן דְּלָתֶ֑יךָ וְתֹאכַ֥ל אֵ֖שׁ בַּאֲרָזֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Open your doors, Lebanon, that the fire may devour your cedars.
controles.kjv: Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.
controles.livre: Abre tuas portas, ó Líbano, para que o fogo consuma teus cedros.

versos.hebraico: הֵילֵ֤ל בְּרוֹשׁ֙ כִּֽי־נָ֣פַל אֶ֔רֶז אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַדִּרִ֖ים שֻׁדָּ֑דוּ הֵילִ֨ילוּ֙ אַלּוֹנֵ֣י בָשָׁ֔ן כִּ֥י יָרַ֖ד יַ֥עַר הבצור׃

controles.web: Wail, fir tree, for the cedar has fallen, because the stately ones are destroyed. Wail, you oaks of Bashan, for the strong forest has come down.
controles.kjv: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: howl, O ye oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.
controles.livre: Lamenta, ó cipreste, porque o cedro caiu, porque os maiorais foram destruídos. Lamentai, ó carvalhos de Basã, porque o forte bosque foi derrubado.

versos.hebraico: ק֚וֹל יִֽלְלַ֣ת הָרֹעִ֔ים כִּ֥י שֻׁדְּדָ֖ה אַדַּרְתָּ֑ם ק֚וֹל שַׁאֲגַ֣ת כְּפִירִ֔ים כִּ֥י שֻׁדַּ֖ד גְּא֥וֹן הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃ס

controles.web: A voice of the wailing of the shepherds! For their glory is destroyed: a voice of the roaring of young lions! For the pride of the Jordan is ruined.
controles.kjv: There is a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.
controles.livre: Ouve-se voz de lamentação de pastores, porque sua glória foi destruída; ouve-se voz dos bramidos de leões jovens, porque a arrogância do Jordão foi destruída.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י רְעֵ֖ה אֶת־צֹ֥אן הַהֲרֵגָֽה׃

controles.web: Thus says Yahweh my God: “Feed the flock of slaughter.
controles.kjv: Thus saith the Lord my God; Feed the flock of the slaughter;
controles.livre: Assim diz o SENHOR meu Deus: Apascenta as ovelhas da matança,

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁ֨ר קֹנֵיהֶ֤ן יַֽהֲרְגֻן֙ וְלֹ֣א יֶאְשָׁ֔מוּ וּמֹכְרֵיהֶ֣ן יֹאמַ֔ר בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֖ה וַאעְשִׁ֑ר וְרֹ֣עֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א יַחְמ֖וֹל עֲלֵיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: Their buyers slaughter them, and go unpunished. Those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be Yahweh, for I am rich;’ and their own shepherds don’t pity them.
controles.kjv: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say, Blessed be the Lord; for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.
controles.livre: Cujos compradores as matam, e ninguém os considera culpados; e os que as vendem dizem: Bendito seja o SENHOR, porque estou rico; nem seus pastores se compadecem delas.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֠י לֹ֣א אֶחְמ֥וֹל ע֛וֹד עַל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י מַמְצִ֣יא אֶת־הָאָדָ֗ם אִ֤ישׁ בְּיַד־רֵעֵ֨הוּ֙ וּבְיַ֣ד מַלְכּ֔וֹ וְכִתְּתוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹ֥א אַצִּ֖יל מִיָּדָֽם׃

controles.web: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land,” says Yahweh; “but, behold, I will deliver the men everyone into his neighbor’s hand, and into the hand of his king. They will strike the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.”
controles.kjv: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith the Lord: but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour’s hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.
controles.livre: Certamente não mais pouparei os moradores da terra,diz o SENHOR; mas eis que eu entregarei os homens, cada um na mão de seu próximo, e em mão de seu rei; e despedaçarão esta terra, e eu não os livrarei de suas mãos.

versos.hebraico: וָֽאֶרְעֶה֙ אֶת־צֹ֣אן הַֽהֲרֵגָ֔ה לָכֵ֖ן עֲנִיֵּ֣י הַצֹּ֑אן וָאֶקַּֽח־לִ֞י שְׁנֵ֣י מַקְל֗וֹת לְאַחַ֞ד קָרָ֤אתִי נֹ֨עַם֙ וּלְאַחַד֙ קָרָ֣אתִי חֹֽבְלִ֔ים וָאֶרְעֶ֖ה אֶת־הַצֹּֽאן׃

controles.web: So I fed the flock of slaughter, especially the oppressed of the flock. I took for myself two staffs. The one I called “Favor”, and the other I called “Union”, and I fed the flock.
controles.kjv: And I will feed the flock of slaughter, even you, O poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.
controles.livre: Então eu apascentei as ovelhas da matança, as pobres do rebanho. E tomei para mim duas varas; a uma chamei Agrado e à outra chamei União; e apascentei as ovelhas.

versos.hebraico: וָאַכְחִ֛ד אֶת־שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת הָרֹעִ֖ים בְּיֶ֣רַח אֶחָ֑ד וַתִּקְצַ֤ר נַפְשִׁי֙ בָּהֶ֔ם וְגַם־נַפְשָׁ֖ם בָּחֲלָ֥ה בִֽי׃

controles.web: I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.
controles.kjv: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.
controles.livre: E acabei com três pastores em um mês, pois minha alma estava impaciente com eles, e também a almas deles me odiavam.

versos.hebraico: וָאֹמַ֕ר לֹ֥א אֶרְעֶ֖ה אֶתְכֶ֑ם הַמֵּתָ֣ה תָמ֗וּת וְהַנִּכְחֶ֨דֶת֙ תִּכָּחֵ֔ד וְהַ֨נִּשְׁאָר֔וֹת תֹּאכַ֕לְנָה אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶת־בְּשַׂ֥ר רְעוּתָֽהּ׃

controles.web: Then I said, “I will not feed you. That which dies, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let those who are left eat each other’s flesh.”
controles.kjv: Then said I, I will not feed you: that that dieth, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.
controles.livre: E eu disse: Não vos apascentarei; a que morrer, morra; e a que se perder, se perca; e as que restarem, que uma devore a carne da outra.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶקַּ֤ח אֶת־מַקְלִי֙ אֶת־נֹ֔עַם וָאֶגְדַּ֖ע אֹת֑וֹ לְהָפֵיר֙ אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖תִּי אֶת־כָּל־הָעַמִּֽים׃

controles.web: I took my staff Favor, and cut it apart, that I might break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples.
controles.kjv: And I took my staff, even Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.
controles.livre: E peguei minha vara Agrado, e a quebrei, para desfazer meu pacto que tinha estabelecido com todos os povos.

versos.hebraico: וַתֻּפַ֖ר בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיֵּדְע֨וּ כֵ֜ן עֲנִיֵּ֤י הַצֹּאן֙ הַשֹּׁמְרִ֣ים אֹתִ֔י כִּ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃

controles.web: It was broken in that day; and thus the poor of the flock that listened to me knew that it was Yahweh’s word.
controles.kjv: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of the Lord.
controles.livre: Assim foi desfeito naquele dia, e assim as pobres do rebanho que me observavam reconheceram que isto era palavra do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וָאֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם אִם־ט֧וֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֛ם הָב֥וּ שְׂכָרִ֖י וְאִם־לֹ֣א׀ חֲדָ֑לוּ וַיִּשְׁקְל֥וּ אֶת־שְׂכָרִ֖י שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים כָּֽסֶף׃

controles.web: I said to them, “If you think it best, give me my wages; and if not, keep them.” So they weighed for my wages thirty pieces of silver.
controles.kjv: And I said unto them, If ye think good, give me my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver.
controles.livre: Pois eu havia lhes dito: Se vos parece bem aos vossos olhos, dai-me meu salário; e se não, deixai-o. E pesaram meu salário: trinta moedas de prata.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י הַשְׁלִיכֵ֨הוּ֙ אֶל־הַיּוֹצֵ֔ר אֶ֣דֶר הַיְקָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָקַ֖רְתִּי מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וָֽאֶקְחָה֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים הַכֶּ֔סֶף וָאַשְׁלִ֥יךְ אֹת֛וֹ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־הַיּוֹצֵֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to me, “Throw it to the potter, the handsome price that I was valued at by them!” I took the thirty pieces of silver, and threw them to the potter, in Yahweh’s house.
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the Lord.
controles.livre: O SENHOR, pois, me disse: Lança-as ao oleiro, este belo preço que me avaliaram.E tomei as trinta moedas de prata, e as lancei na casa do SENHOR ao oleiro.

versos.hebraico: וָֽאֶגְדַּע֙ אֶת־מַקְלִ֣י הַשֵּׁנִ֔י אֵ֖ת הַחֹֽבְלִ֑ים לְהָפֵר֙ אֶת־הָֽאַחֲוָ֔ה בֵּ֥ין יְהוּדָ֖ה וּבֵ֥ין יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: Then I cut apart my other staff, even Union, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
controles.kjv: Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
controles.livre: Então quebrei logo minha segunda vara União, rompendo a fraternidade entre Judá e Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י ע֣וֹד קַח־לְךָ֔ כְּלִ֖י רֹעֶ֥ה אֱוִלִֽי׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to me, “Take for yourself yet again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto me, Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR me disse mais: Toma ainda para ti os instrumentos de um pastor insensato;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י הִנֵּֽה־אָנֹכִי֩ מֵקִ֨ים רֹעֶ֜ה בָּאָ֗רֶץ הַנִּכְחָד֤וֹת לֹֽא־יִפְקֹד֙ הַנַּ֣עַר לֹֽא־יְבַקֵּ֔שׁ וְהַנִּשְׁבֶּ֖רֶת לֹ֣א יְרַפֵּ֑א הַנִּצָּבָה֙ לֹ֣א יְכַלְכֵּ֔ל וּבְשַׂ֤ר הַבְּרִיאָה֙ יֹאכַ֔ל וּפַרְסֵיהֶ֖ן יְפָרֵֽק׃ס

controles.web: For, behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, who will not visit those who are cut off, neither will seek those who are scattered, nor heal that which is broken, nor feed that which is sound; but he will eat the flesh of the fat sheep, and will tear their hoofs in pieces.
controles.kjv: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, which shall not visit those that be cut off, neither shall seek the young one, nor heal that that is broken, nor feed that that standeth still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their claws in pieces.
controles.livre: Porque eis que eu levantarei um pastor na terra, que não cuidará das perdidas, não buscará a pequena, não tratará de curar a que estiver machucada, nem apascentará a sã; em vez disso, ele comerá a carne da que estiver gorda, e quebrará suas unhas.

versos.hebraico: ה֣וֹי רֹעִ֤י הָֽאֱלִיל֙ עֹזְבִ֣י הַצֹּ֔אן חֶ֥רֶב עַל־זְרוֹע֖וֹ וְעַל־עֵ֣ין יְמִינ֑וֹ זְרֹעוֹ֙ יָב֣וֹשׁ תִּיבָ֔שׁ וְעֵ֥ין יְמִינ֖וֹ כָּהֹ֥ה תִכְהֶֽה׃ס

controles.web: Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock! The sword will be on his arm, and on his right eye. His arm will be completely withered, and his right eye will be totally blinded!”
controles.kjv: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.
controles.livre: Ai do pastor inútil, que desampara o rebanho! Espada virá contra seu braço, e contra seu olho direito; seu braço se secará por completo, e seu olho direito será obscurecido.
